nav.titulo_presentacion: Full Stack Developer, focused on Frontend development with experience building web applications from start to finish.
nav.descripcion1_presentacion: As a University Technician in Programming, I have developed web applications mainly using React.js, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS to build modern and responsive interfaces. I have worked on both personal and team projects, including an application for the Directorate of Agriculture – Tobacco Division, where I worked on features focused on certificate and inspection management.
nav.descripcion2_presentacion: In addition to frontend development, I have experience with Node.js, Express, MySQL, and MongoDB, building REST APIs, implementing CRUD operations, and contributing to the development of full-stack applications. This experience allows me to understand the overall structure of a project and contribute throughout its entire development lifecycle.
